chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shazaan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one performing 'Umra may perform 'Umra in whichever month of the year he desires, and the most superior 'Umra is the 'Umra of Rajab.
ai.seo_question: When is the best time to perform Umra according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Safwan ibn Yahya, underscores the general permissibility of 'Umra throughout the year while elevating the month of Rajab to a position of special merit, a view supported by Shia scholars who link it to the spiritual preparation for Ramadan. The emphasis on Rajab reflects the broader Shia tradition of assigning specific virtues to the early months of the lunar calendar, encouraging believers to engage in extra worship during this time. This flexibility allows for personal devotion while maintaining the distinct sanctity of Rajab as a time for spiritual renewal.
